Professional Summary
Backend-focused software engineer specializing in Golang development for distributed systems and financial services. Proven track record delivering high-throughput, low-latency microservices, improving system reliability, and driving efficient DB designs. Open to relocating to Pune. Notice period: 15 days.

- Optimized Postgres schema and queries for high-volume reconciliation workflows, reducing nightly job runtime from 7 hours to 90 minutes while maintaining strong consistency via gRPC service contracts.

- Implemented robust data ingestion pipelines and backpressure mechanisms using gRPC for inter-service streaming, improving system stability during peak loads by 40%.
- Documented service interfaces, deployment runbooks, and postmortems in Confluence to streamline on-call handovers and reduce MTTR.

Backend Engineer, Saffron Bank (Feb 2017 - Mar 2017)
- Built Go-based Microservices exposing gRPC endpoints for internal banking modules, integrating with Postgres for transaction persistence and reconciliation.
- Wrote migration scripts and optimized Postgres indices to support daily batch clearing, cutting failure rates in reconciliation by half.
- Collaborated on containerization strategy and deployment manifests for Docker-based environments to standardize dev/test workflows.

Go Developer, HCLTech (Mar 2012 - Jan 2017)
